description: This file defines the SummaryDisplayField class within the OrangeHRM system. The class maps to the database table 'ohrm_summary_display_field' using Doctrine ORM annotations. It represents a configurable display field in summaries, including properties such as label, width, sortable options, and associations with display field groups and selected group fields.

classes.name: SummaryDisplayField
classes.description: An entity class mapping to the 'ohrm_summary_display_field' table, encapsulating properties for display configuration, including labels, sorting, width, and relationships with other entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the selectedGroupFields property as a new ArrayCollection.
